preconditions.description: The number of parts n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of ropes m must be between 0 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= vi <= 10**5 for vi in v)
preconditions.description: Each energy value vi must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in ropes)
preconditions.description: Each rope must connect two distinct parts within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total energy required to remove all parts.
